details:
On all GameObjects in my Avatar Project, the first Contact Receiver is missing on the uploaded Avatar within the Game. This includes Bones and empty GameObjects.

When I run the preview within Unity, all Contacts are normal and present as expected.

Some test-cases:

I have a GameObject with 1 Contact Receiver: It is missing

I have a GameObject with 2 Contact Receivers: The "first" (topmost) contact is missing

I have a GameObject with Contact Receiver, and a Constraint before it: The Contact is missing.

Placing a "dummy"-Contact Receiver above/before in the hierachy of the GameObject in each case yields the expected Receivers present, and the dummy missing.

Tested on Unity 2022.3.22f1 with SDK Versions 3.5.0 and above.

GameVersion as far as I can remember for at least a month.

Contact Senders work as expected.

Contact Receivers are of different types (Spheres, Capsules, Custom Collision Tags, Standard Collision Tags, Different Receiver Types)
title: First Contact Receiver Component in Hierachy is not uploaded with Avatar
